Follow-up in 6 weeks for methotrexate labs and response.

Shave biopsy performed today with apixaban continued; hemostasis with aluminum chloride and pressure. Addendum, pathology: nodular basal cell carcinoma. Patient notified by phone and referred for Mohs micrographic surgery because of the nasal tip location.
note.patientInstructions: Apply petrolatum and a bandage daily. Hold firm pressure for 15 minutes if the site bleeds. Continue apixaban as prescribed.
note.carePlanSummary: Biopsy-proven nodular basal cell carcinoma of the nasal tip referred for Mohs surgery.

appointments.prepInstructions: Bring a current medication list. Do not stop apixaban before the visit.
Continue apixaban unless cardiology advises otherwise. Eat a normal breakfast and arrange a ride home.

problems.display: Basal cell carcinoma of skin of nose

patients.carePlanSummary: Treat actinic keratoses of the nose and reinforce sun protection and smoking cessation.

medications.quantityInfo: Apply to the nose twice daily for 3 weeks

note.ccHPI: {age}-year-old man with decades of outdoor work presents with rough, tender spots on the nose for several months. Current smoker. No bleeding or rapid growth.
note.reviewOfSystems: Denies bleeding, pain at rest, or non-healing sores.
note.examFindings: Nasal dorsum and right nasal sidewall: three discrete erythematous, scaly, sandpaper-like papules measuring 3 to 4 mm. No induration or infiltration.
note.impressionsAndPlan: Actinic keratoses of the nose, 3 lesions. Liquid nitrogen cryotherapy applied to all three lesions (single 10-second freeze-thaw cycle). Fluorouracil 5% cream twice daily for 3 weeks as field therapy once the treated sites have healed, in about 2 weeks. Counseled on sun protection, hats and smoking cessation. Return in 2 months to reassess and retreat any persistent lesions.
note.patientInstructions: Expect blistering or crusting at the treated sites. Do not pick the crusts. Start fluorouracil after the crusts fall off.
note.followUpPlan: Return in 2 months for reassessment and repeat cryotherapy if needed.
note.carePlanSummary: Destruction and field treatment of precancerous lesions on the nose.

appointments.prepInstructions: Do not apply creams to the nose on the day of the visit.
